gloss: to guess correctly; to hit upon

definitions.gloss: to guess correctly; to hit upon
definitions.explanation: To correctly identify or predict something, often surprising others with one's accuracy.

examples.japanese: {彼|かれ}は{私|わたし}の{考|かんが}えを{見事|みごと}に{言|い}い{当|あ}てた。
{占|うらな}い{師|し}が{私|わたし}の{過去|かこ}を{言|い}い{当|あ}てて{驚|おどろ}いた。
examples.english: I was surprised when the fortune teller correctly guessed my past.

examples.japanese: {犯人|はんにん}を{言|い}い{当|あ}てるのは{難|むずか}しい。
examples.english: It's difficult to correctly identify the culprit.

notes:
CONJUGATION:
・{言|い}い{当|あ}てる → {言|い}い{当|あ}てない (negative)
・{言|い}い{当|あ}てる → {言|い}い{当|あ}てて (te-form)
・{言|い}い{当|あ}てる → {言|い}い{当|あ}てた (past)

FORMATION:
Compound verb: {言|い}う (to say) + {当|あ}てる (to hit the mark)

USAGE:
・{正解|せいかい}を{言|い}い{当|あ}てる (to guess the correct answer)
・{本心|ほんしん}を{言|い}い{当|あ}てる (to hit upon someone's true feelings)
・{未来|みらい}を{言|い}い{当|あ}てる (to predict the future correctly)

NUANCE:
Implies impressive accuracy, not just a lucky guess. Often used when someone demonstrates insight or intuition.
